answer: Rotation is published in the raven index and the vertex audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 271 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the tundra beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
